name: Kare to Kare no Hazama De Saikon Kazoku Hen
original_name: カレと彼の間で 再婚家族編
source: One night, Mizuho had a dream where she was a child and two kids made for her a clover ring and a flower headband. She didn't care about it, but at school she crashed into two boys and got her hair stuck into their uniform buttons. After this incident, she got back home... to discover her widow mother married their father! Mizuho decides to deal with it, but maybe they'll get closer than she thinks...
translation: 某天夜里，白石瑞穗梦见自己回到童年，两个孩子为她编了四叶草戒指与花朵头带。她并未把梦放在心上，却在学校撞上两名男生，头发还缠进了他们的制服纽扣。事件过后，她回到家中……竟发现寡居的母亲嫁给了两人的父亲！瑞穗决定接受现实，但三人的关系也许会比她预想的更加亲密……
